name: routed-model-nested-calibration-v1
routing: Normalized policy membership in the actual fitted training partition; no validation/test target or cohort statistic
outer_splits: Reuse the three seen-policy and four held-out-policy purged splits exactly
familiar_calibration: For each outer split, train three inner feature/classifier pipelines on purged inner training data; fit one sigmoid to their OOF predictions; score the untouched outer validation with its existing verified outer model
unseen_calibration: Fit one sigmoid to fixed centroid scores and labels of each purged outer training partition, then score only its held-out policy
final_fit: Fit the seven-family familiar pipeline and lexical reference on development only; fit retained route calibrators on development OOF/frozen scores only
confirmation_followup: Commit exact fitted artifacts, candidate/reference, eligible row identities and acceptance criteria before opening any reserved target
checkpoint: Preserve completed inner fits, feature screens, prediction records and final artifacts; source/data/config mismatches cannot reuse a stage
scope: Development selection remains adaptive to prior feature work; nested calibration isolates its validation labels but does not undo earlier feature selection
